description: Class for handling width/height length attribute transformations to CSS in the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Length
classes.description: Handles transformation of length attributes (such as width or height) into CSS style declarations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the transform with the attribute name and optional CSS property name.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attribute into a CSS style, appending 'px' if the value is a digit.
